cases.name: Isabella Mehner
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She loved her family and her home. She lived in her home on Cove Rd. for 66 years and loved living in Stamford and despite her advanced age, never wanted to leave her beloved home. She was an avid gardener and loved knitting. Her neighbors would see her in her garden everyday even at the age of 93. And in the evenings, she knitted sweaters and hats for all the grandchildren. She will be missed by many but mostly by her family."
cases.narrative: She was found at the bottom of her basement stairs and at first it appeared to be an accident, but there were injuries to her face and head that were not consistent with a fall down the stairs.
